maria: Quick heads-up — spotted two broken things in the KB runtime examples while digging through a customer repro. The curl example in docs/runtime/quickstart.md links to a gist (https://gist.github.com/old-snippet-12345) that 404s, and the sample output image is returning 403 from the CDN. Can someone who owns that page either rehost the gist + image or point me to the replacement?
kevin: I can pick this up. Are both assets in the same file? pinging @oliver for owners list.
maria: Yep both referenced from the same section at the top under "Quick curl test". I tried a quick sed locally to swap the gist URL but don't want to commit without owner confirmation: `sed -i "s|https://gist.github.com/old-snippet-12345|https://gist.github.com/new-snippet-67890|g" docs/runtime/quickstart.md`
oliver: Heads-up — docs-bot shows owners for that path are @lina and me. @lina usually rehosts external snips to our internal snippets bucket. docs-bot: Owners for docs/runtime/* = @oliver, @lina (auto-assigned)
lina: I can rehost the snippet and image to our assets bucket, then open a tiny PR to update the URLs. Kevin, if you want to prepare the PR patch we can merge it together.
kevin: Cool — I'll open the PR and attach the new rehosted URLs. ETA 2pm today. PR link once created.
maria: Awesome — thanks all. If anyone hits the curl example in the wild, there's a short-term workaround: replace the gist URL with `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/redwood-inference/snippets/main/runtime/quick-curl.txt` and the image with `https://assets.redwood-inference.com/runtime/quick-output.png` until the PR lands.
kevin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/853 — request review from @oliver and @lina.
oliver: Quick review done, left one nit on alt text for the image. lgtm otherwise.
lina: Merged — thanks Kevin. Maria, should be good now; can you verify the staging preview?
maria: Verified on staging — links resolve and the curl example runs. Closing out here. :thumbsup:
